# Modern Data Engineer & Lakehouse Architect
> The Definitive Enterprise Reference Platform for Lakehouse Architecture, Medallion Architecture, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Apache Spark 4.0, and Distributed Systems.

Website: https://moderndataengineer.uk
Canonical Domain: https://moderndataengineer.uk
Platform Edition: 2026 Enterprise Edition
Author: Santosh Jammi

## Overview
Lakehouse Architect (moderndataengineer.uk) is an open-access enterprise architecture encyclopedia and preparation portal engineered for Principal Data Architects, Staff Data Engineers, and Lead Analytics Engineers. It provides 11,500+ verified interview scenarios, 679 architectural concepts, 42 digital whiteboard blueprints, and dedicated Spark execution labs.

## Core Architecture Pillars & Hubs
- [Lakehouse Architecture Hub](https://moderndataengineer.uk/architecture): 3,206+ production system design scenarios, distributed failure modes, and architectural trade-offs.
- [Concepts & Foundations Glossary](https://moderndataengineer.uk/concepts): 679 core lakehouse concepts covering Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Unity Catalog, and Medallion patterns.
- [Spark Engine Lab](https://moderndataengineer.uk/spark-engine): Interactive physical execution simulator, Tungsten memory geometry, and shuffle stage mechanics for Apache Spark 4.0.
- [QA Prep Portal](https://moderndataengineer.uk/qa-prep): 6,800+ verified interview drills covering DP-600, DP-203, and Databricks Professional exams.
- [Production Cheat Sheets & PDF Hub](https://moderndataengineer.uk/cheat-sheet): 124+ high-density runbooks, Sev-1 incident triage guides, and 7 compiled master vector PDFs.
- [DataOps Lifecycle](https://moderndataengineer.uk/dataops): End-to-end data platform CI/CD, Git integration, schema evolution, and deployment pipelines.
- [Modern Data Stack Hub](https://moderndataengineer.uk/modern-stack): Comparative Polyglot Matrix and Cost Playbooks across Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Fabric, and DuckDB.
- [Databricks Coding Hub](https://moderndataengineer.uk/code-practice/databricks): 148+ operations with code templates, certification mappings, and production memory bottleneck triage playbooks.

## Key Technologies Covered
- Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Direct Lake, Synapse Data Engineering, Data Factory)
- Databricks Lakehouse (Unity Catalog, Photon Engine, Delta Live Tables, Delta Sharing)
- Open Table Formats (Delta Lake 3.x, Apache Iceberg V2, Apache Hudi)
- Distributed Query & Compute (Apache Spark 4.0, Trino, DuckDB, Velox)
- Medallion Architecture (Bronze: Raw Ingestion, Silver: Conformed/Cleaned, Gold: Curated Dimensional Marts)
